description: This file defines the CriteriaQueryFactory class, which provides utility methods for constructing and executing JPA criteria queries, including pagination, ordering, and applying specifications.

classes.name: CriteriaQueryFactory
classes.description: A Spring component class that facilitates building and executing JPA criteria queries with support for pagination, sorting, and specifications.

methods.name: ordersFromPageable
methods.description: Generates a list of Order objects based on the Pageable's sort order.

methods.name: ordersFromPageable (overloaded)
methods.description: Generates a list of Order objects with a default order supplier if no sort is specified.

methods.name: readPage
methods.description: Executes a paginated query and returns a Page of results, including total count.

methods.name: executeCountQuery
methods.description: Executes a count query and sums up the total number of records.

methods.name: getCountQuery
methods.description: Builds a count query based on a specification and domain class.

methods.name: applySpecificationToCriteria
methods.description: Applies a Specification's predicate to a CriteriaQuery.
